newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Prosure sold to Mutual&Federal, Comm Union.
newsitem.headline: Prosure sold to Mutual&Federal, Comm Union.

text.p: Protea Assuarance Co Ltd (Prosure) said on Thursday that Mutual & Federal would acquire the entire share capital of Prosure as well as its general insurance business, while Commercial Union has acquired Protea Life and Protea Assurance Investment Management.
Mutual & Federal (M&F) has offered to buy Prosure ordinary shares on the basis of 510 M&F shares for every 100 Prosure ordinary shares held.
Based on an M&F share price of 24.90 rand, the offer values Prosure at 1.024 billion rand or 127 rand per Prosure ordinary share.
Commercial Union's (CU) cash offer for Protea Life and the investment business totalled 252 million rand.
The acquistion is with effect from close of business on October 31.
M&F managing director Ken Saggers said: "A number of synergies exist between the two operations which can now be harnessed to the advantage of policyholders, intermediaries and shareholders."

CU managing director Roger Wanless said CU would be able to expand its product range, gain access to new distribution channels and benefit from rationalisation, which will place it in an excellent position to provide superior returns on its life business in the medium to long term.
The sale of Prosure was prompted by the July merger between Sun Alliance and Royal Insurance, the company said.
The Royal & Sun Alliance merger meant that the group had two competing interests in South Africa -- a 77.8 percent shareholding in Prosure and a 38.5 percent stake in competing insurer M&F.
The decision was then taken to retain their economic interest in M&F and dispose of their investment in Prosure.
A joint board sub-committee has been put in place by Prosure and the new owners and corporate governance would be in the hands of the committee until the date of ownership transfer.
